message:
Fix default-profile HA fixture and snapshot audit test compilation

Initialize the two native-v6-ha snapshot fields in the existing listener-free HA test fixtures. Keep the callback absent and the peer-pin map empty. Replace two unstable ExactSizeIterator::is_empty assertions with equivalent stable zero-length assertions.

Repairs the four actual default libtest compiler errors from 5767739c. Production code, test names, assertions, deadlines, dependencies and the 252/280 selected test plan are otherwise unchanged. This source commit is not a runtime qualification.
